question.html:
A solid block of glass is covered with water. The diagram shows the path of a monochromatic light ray entering the water from the glass block.

The speed of light in the glass is 2.0 × 108 m s−1.

a Calculate the speed of light in the water. State the answer to an appropriate number of significant figures. [3]

b Explain the change in the wavelength of the light at the glass–water boundary. [2]

c Draw, on the diagram, the path of the reflected ray. [1]

d Determine whether light emerges from the glass block into the air. [3]
